steps: Run: STRATEGIES=always_expand SEEDS=1 TAG=fast qa/bots/run_batch.sh qa/bots/out_2026-10-26
Cycle 1: buy ship 1 at Voltara (planet 0) for 1000 cr, buy energy, send the ship (trip cost 40).
Cycle 3: buy ship 2 with no cash reserve.
Cycles 4 to 5: sell cargo, spend the rest, cash falls to 29.
From cycle 5: ship docked, 29 cr is below trip_cost 40, cargo empty. No trade or send is possible.
Cycles 5 to 30: nothing changes; the game ends at cycle 30 as a loss with cash 29.
expected: A bankrupt state is either recoverable (income possible) or ends the run early as a loss. The player is not left idle for 25 cycles.
actual: Dead state from cycle 5. No action can raise cash. Identical for seeds 2 to 5. Result: loss at cycle 30, final_cash 29, ships 2.

steps: Run: STRATEGIES=sloppy SEEDS=1 TAG=fast qa/bots/run_batch.sh qa/bots/out_2026-10-26
Cycle 1: buy ship 1 at Voltara, buy max energy, send to Tillam.
Cycle 4: buy ship 2 with all remaining cash, cash falls to 4.
From cycle 4: ship docked at a planet with 4 cr (trip_cost 40), cargo empty. No action can raise cash.
expected: Bankruptcy is recoverable or ends the run early as a loss, not an idle 26 cycles.
actual: Dead state from cycle 4 until the cycle-30 loss. Identical for seeds 2 to 5. final_cash 4, ships 2.

steps: Run: STRATEGIES="decent sloppy always_expand never_expand" SEEDS=1 TAG=fast qa/bots/run_batch.sh qa/bots/out_2026-10-26
Each run plays to the end with debug_advance_cycle(). Win cash is 9000 (balance win_cash), win cycle 30.
Read final_cash for each strategy from results_fast.jsonl.
expected: A reasonable single-route income line reaches win_cash in the target window (win cycle 25 to 28, per balance targets), so a win is reachable.
actual: No strategy wins. never_expand: 8380 at cycle 30 (620 short). decent: 1380 (8 ships). always_expand: 29. sloppy: 4. The best line only gets to about 7820 by cycle 28, so the 25 to 28 window cannot be reached by income alone. Identical for seeds 2 to 5.

steps: Run: STRATEGIES="decent never_expand" SEEDS=1 TAG=fast qa/bots/run_batch.sh qa/bots/out_2026-10-26
decent buys ships on the cash-reserve rule (8 ships by cycle 28). never_expand keeps 1 ship.
Compare final_cash at cycle 30.
expected: Extra ships either add income or capacity, or the cost is a visible trade-off. Expansion should not be strictly worse.
actual: Ship count has no effect on income in this build: trade.gd has one ship_planet and one dest, capacity() is cargo only (20), and ships only gate send(). Each extra ship costs 1000 cr and adds nothing. never_expand ends 8380, decent 1380, always_expand 29. Expansion is strictly dominated.

steps: Run: STRATEGIES=never_expand SEEDS=1 TAG=fast qa/bots/run_batch.sh qa/bots/out_2026-10-26 (final_cash 8380, legs_sent 30).
Run: STRATEGIES="decent never_expand" SEEDS=1 EXTRA="--clock=timer" TAG=timer qa/bots/run_batch.sh qa/bots/out_2026-10-26 (never_expand final_cash 5580, legs_sent 20).
Same decisions in both. Only the clock differs (debug_advance_cycle vs real _process chunks of 1 to 45 s).
expected: A cycle played on the real timer and a cycle played with debug_advance_cycle() give the same economy for the same decisions.
actual: Timer run loses 10 legs and 2800 cr. A ship sent part-way through a cycle lands in the next cycle, after the bot's cycle-start decision point, so it can only send again a cycle later. Cause is partly the bot acting only at cycle start, and partly that trip arrival is processed only on the timer. The fast-forward economy is the optimistic bound. Needs a ruling on whether a ship arriving mid-cycle may trade in that cycle.

steps: Run: qa/bots/run_batch.sh with the four strategies, seed 1, TAG=fast.
Read cash_at 10, 20, 25 in results_fast.jsonl and compare with balance pace targets 3000, 6000, 7500.
Read ship_buys for the decent run. Compare the 8th ship with target_8_ships_cycle 18.
expected: Pace targets met: cash 3000 at cycle 10, 6000 at 20, 7500 at 25. Eighth ship about cycle 18.
actual: Every strategy is behind. decent: cycle 10 cash 780, cycle 20 1580, cycle 25 980; 8th ship at cycle 28. never_expand: 2780, 5580, 6980. No decent run wins, so the 'decent wins before 22 or after 30' check does not fire, but pacing is far off target.
